name: MavenExists
description: Checks whether a Maven artifact is already in Lucee's local maven cache — a cheap filesystem-only predicate with no network or tree walk.

params.name: groupId
params.description: The Maven group identifier, or a gradle-style coordinate string `"group:artifact"` / `"group:artifact:version"` when passed as the only argument.

params.name: artifactId
params.description: The Maven artifact identifier. Omit when passing a gradle-style coordinate as the first argument.

params.name: version
params.description: The specific version to check for. If omitted, the function returns true when any cached version of the coord is present.
